literal_meaning: জাহান্নামের ব্যবসায়ী বা খেলোয়াড় (hell's trader or player)
figurative_meaning_en: cunning with evil intent; impostor; swindler, etc.
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা মহা জাঁহাবাজ লোক, কাউকে বিশ্বাস করিস না।
এই জাঁহাবাজের কথায় কান দিস না, সবাইকে ঠকায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real swindler, don't trust him.
Don't listen to that con artist; he cheats everyone.
history: Derived from Persian-Arabic 'Jahannam' (hell) combined with 'baz' (dealer/player), reflecting Islamic influences in Bengali idiom usage for describing morally corrupt individuals.
note: Primarily used in negative contexts in Bengali, with roots in Islamic terminology.
